oauthInfo:
1. Click the login link below and login with your Navimow account
2. After login you will be redirected - copy the complete URL from the browser address bar
The URL contains ?code=XXXXX
3. Paste the URL below and save
authCodeHelp: Paste the full URL or just the code value
intervalHelp: Periodic HTTP status polling interval (0 = disabled, MQTT only). MQTT remains active for real-time updates.
mapEnabledHelp: Off by default: drawing costs about 80 ms and a 65 KiB state write every few seconds while the mower is out. Everything below only applies when this is on.
mapLineColorHelp: Leave empty for the gradient from blue (start) to green (current position).
mapLineOpacityHelp: 1 = opaque. Lower values let a background image show through.
mapMarkerSizeHelp: The mower needs about 16 to 24 px to be recognisable as one.
mapRenderIntervalHelp: Drawing the map costs about 80 ms and a 65 KiB state write, which is why it does not follow every position. The default of 3 keeps the picture within about a metre and a half of the mower. 2 is the smoothest the mower reports and the most expensive; a weak host or a large lawn is better off higher.
